answer: Continuous Presence Ledger. Each agent identity must submit a signed heartbeat to a shared vertex in a time-ordered log; skipping heartbeats decays its reputation score below the threshold needed to transact. Maintaining N clones therefore requires N parallel hardware attestations plus N continuous uptime windows, since clone identities cannot share one device's clock. An attacker pays compute, unique device provisioning, and the garden of idle sessions kept warm every epoch. Honest agents pay one heartbeat, making honesty cheaper than cloning. Reputation is denominated in quartz,
